problem_statement: Long study or work sessions feel isolating, and people want gentle support without productivity tracking pressure.
target_user: students and remote workers who study or work long hours
distinctive_notes: Custom 3D-printed case, BME280 plus air-quality sensors, mic loudness and camera mood cues; hourly non-judgmental check-in. Electron UI, Express on the Pi, React Native app. Has a live site.
sponsor_fit_note: Gemini processes session and environment data in the mobile app to generate insights for the user.

one_line_pitch: Web tool that sends the same request to two API versions, diffs the JSON, and uses an NVIDIA Nemotron RAG agent to write a change report.
problem_statement: Developers struggle to track and document API changes between versions and assess migration impact.
target_user: developers and employees maintaining API-dependent codebases
distinctive_notes: Client-side JSON diffing feeds a FastAPI backend calling Nemotron; README additionally mentions a 0-100 migration risk score and Markdown export. Writeup says team gathered feedback from sponsor reps.
sponsor_fit_note: Built for the State Farm API-versioning challenge and also used NVIDIA Nemotron for the RAG-generated change reports.

one_line_pitch: iOS app that reminds group members of shared shopping-list items when they are near a store and splits receipts via AI scanning.
problem_statement: People forget small errands for shared lists and spend time manually splitting grocery bills among roommates or family.
target_user: roommates and families sharing errands and bills
distinctive_notes: Native SwiftUI app using geofencing for nearby-store alerts; Apple Vision OCR output is cleaned into line items by Gemini.

one_line_pitch: iOS app that reminds group members of shared shopping-list items when near a relevant store and splits receipts via AI scanning.
problem_statement: People forget small errands and waste time manually splitting grocery bills among roommates or family.
distinctive_notes: Combines geofenced reminders with OCR plus Gemini receipt parsing; Gemini was added after Vision OCR alone could not produce clean item lists. Repo is a single Xcode project.

one_line_pitch: Contract management platform with AI-assisted drafting, multi-party approvals, escrowed milestone payments and Solana-anchored document hashes.
problem_statement: Slow, opaque partnership agreements leave clients unsure what they pay for and delay projects.
target_user: businesses and their clients/vendors negotiating contracts
distinctive_notes: Three Solana programs in Rust/Anchor (deals, reputation, escrow); IPFS for documents; Gemini extracts requirements and scores fraud risk. Writeup lists several phases as future work.
sponsor_fit_note: Contract hashes, deal state, reputation and escrow are implemented as Solana programs; CBRE fit is not stated beyond B2B deal management.
unverified_fields: repo (linked but clone failed, private or deleted)

one_line_pitch: Pixel-art gamified dashboard that shows data points as potion cauldrons, with a Nemotron-powered chatbot, network map and route optimization.
problem_statement: Wanted to make data and network analysis visually engaging rather than plain charts.
target_user: analysts monitoring network or asset data
distinctive_notes: Hand-made pixel art and animations on a Flask backend; deployed to a custom domain. Includes historical playback and optimal route map.
sponsor_fit_note: Dashboard tracks cauldron data points with an AI chatbot; the EOG-specific challenge link is not explained in the writeup.

one_line_pitch: Mobile-style app that maps nearby food and drink pop-ups for consumers and lets vendors post events and track visit counts instead of ratings.
problem_statement: Small pop-up food vendors without a social following struggle to reach customers, and food fans struggle to find pop-ups.
target_user: food lovers and small pop-up vendors
distinctive_notes: Mostly a Figma prototype (Figma Make export) with a Vite code bundle; team included first-time hackers from non-CS majors. Chose visit counts over ratings by design. Business/go-to-market plan featured in writeup.

one_line_pitch: AI console that turns a product PDF or chat-built PRD into department subprojects with estimates and pushes them to Jira with a live dashboard.
problem_statement: Product managers manually break product documents into tasks, estimates and Jira tickets, which takes hours.
distinctive_notes: Three named GPT-4 Turbo agents (PDF, decomposition, PRD consultant); dashboard polls Jira every 2 seconds; storage can be local or S3.

one_line_pitch: Multi-agent product-management copilot where several Nemotron models handle research, strategy, design and PRD generation.
problem_statement: Product managers lose time on documentation, research and coordination instead of strategy.
distinctive_notes: Claims no central orchestrator among agents; RAG added to a Nemotron model; Figma used for design output. Repo README lists seven agents and many status markdown files. Repo named ProdigyPM in README.
sponsor_fit_note: Built directly on the PNC challenge about reimagining the product manager role with GenAI, using Nemotron models for each agent.

one_line_pitch: Multi-agent LLM command center that links product-management tools and turns strategy and KPIs into Jira/ADO-ready stories.
problem_statement: PMs waste time on copy-paste glue across Jira, Confluence and chats, and strategy rarely flows into backlog stories.
distinctive_notes: Adapter layer gives Jira and Azure DevOps parity; agent loops capped at three to limit drift; demo uses mock analytics CSV rather than live data.
sponsor_fit_note: PNC track fit appears to be a workplace productivity tool; no PNC-specific API is named on the page.

project_name: ProDuh! - The "duh" way to ship smarter
one_line_pitch: Multi-agent AI command center covering the product lifecycle, turning goals into Jira or Azure DevOps ready stories and keeping docs linked.
problem_statement: Product managers waste hours copying between Jira, Confluence and chats, and strategy drifts from sprint work.
distinctive_notes: App-agnostic adapter layer for Jira and Azure DevOps plus Confluence, Graph, ServiceNow and GitHub drivers; agent loops capped at three; mock analytics CSV stands in for real data. Pitched as a 2-minute demo.
sponsor_fit_note: Targets the PNC product-manager lifecycle challenge with an LLM agent layer over Jira/ADO and Confluence.

one_line_pitch: AI-assisted API regression tool that diffs two API versions, auto-generates tests and explains breaking changes with visual health dashboards.
problem_statement: Debugging breaking changes between API versions is slow and manual for QA and backend teams.
distinctive_notes: Uses Nemotron to plan test workflows and Gemini to explain regressions; includes regression heatmap and service health score. Repo had 23 commits during the event and one in December 2025.
sponsor_fit_note: Applies API version regression testing to the State Farm challenge area, using LLMs to generate tests and explain failures.
impact_claims_note: States target user counts (tens of thousands of engineers) and up to 80 percent faster diagnosis, no sourcing.
unverified_fields: sponsor_fit_note (State Farm challenge text not seen)

prizes.prize: Best Use of ElevenLabs by MLH

sponsor_apis_used: ElevenLabs (claimed by prize only; not seen in README)
sponsor_fit_note: Prize is MLH Best Use of ElevenLabs, but README names no voice or ElevenLabs usage; usage not verified.
one_line_pitch: Agentic assistant for data center technicians that plans and runs SSH-based verification checks, with a Jira chat companion and an AR camera overlay.
problem_statement: Data center technicians need help running checks and working through maintenance tasks; Devpost writeup itself is missing so the exact stated problem is unknown.
distinctive_notes: Devpost description failed to save; the page only has updates pointing to the README. Repo has LangGraph deep agent, SSH verifier, Jira agent and an OpenCV AprilTag AR overlay (data feed not wired).

one_line_pitch: Kid-oriented banking app where an NFC Spendy card authorises in-game currency purchases and parents review spending and reload funds.
problem_statement: Digital payments make money intangible, so children struggle to visualise spending and manage their own money.
distinctive_notes: Mascot-driven UI shows each dollar as a Spendy character; NFC card tap confirms purchases of Robux or Valorant Points; Figma link listed alongside the repo.
sponsor_fit_note: Financial-literacy app for kids targeting the Capital One track; no Capital One API named.

one_line_pitch: Onboarding platform for banks that manages clients from lead prospecting through full onboarding with role-based dashboards.
problem_statement: Financial institutions lose efficiency to manual client onboarding processes.
distinctive_notes: Multi-role system (clients, vendors, employees) with sales pipeline, client list and risk assessment screens; no AI mentioned in the writeup.
sponsor_fit_note: Banking onboarding workflow tool fitted to the Goldman Sachs track; no Goldman API named.

one_line_pitch: Datacenter technician coordination: mobile web app with tickets, checklists, chat and path planning, an engineer dashboard, and an iOS AR pointer app.
problem_statement: Datacenter tickets suffer delays and poor visibility into where technicians are and how work is progressing.
distinctive_notes: Two repos: a Next.js/Supabase web app (with Python folder) and a separate iOS RealityKit AR app letting a remote user point at a server item. Jira board shown in screenshots.
sponsor_fit_note: Datacenter-operations tool entered for Northmark Compute & Cloud; no Northmark-specific API named in the writeup.
unverified_fields: live demo (repo About lists a Vercel link that could not be fetched)

one_line_pitch: AI car-buying concierge that surveys shoppers, recommends Toyotas, chats or simulates phone calls, and books test drives and emails quotes.
problem_statement: Car shoppers lack confidence, time and knowledge to take the first step toward buying.
distinctive_notes: Named from Toyota plus Nemotron to target two sponsor tracks; multi-agent orchestration with tool layer for email, calendar and trade-in estimates; phone-style voice agent via Retell.
sponsor_fit_note: Built explicitly for the Toyota and Nvidia tracks: Nemotron powers agent reasoning for a Toyota shopping assistant.
Framed around CBRE commercial property data, though the demo uses self-made mock property profiles because CBRE data is private.
one_line_pitch: Real estate browsing app with a Google Maps interface where a Gemini assistant fact-checks property data against Google Search and assigns each listing a trust score.
problem_statement: Consumers cannot tell whether online property listing information is reliable or current.
distinctive_notes: Property data is a mock properties.json imitating CBRE data; saved items persist in browser localStorage. Gemini uses tool-calling with Google Search to verify facts and produce confidence meters.

one_line_pitch: Multi-agent system that extracts vendor PDF data, screens against sanctions lists, scores risk by rules, and requires human sign-off before granting access.
problem_statement: Onboarding vendors and clients is slow, inconsistent and risky because teams manually review documents and databases.
target_user: compliance and vendor-onboarding teams at enterprises
distinctive_notes: ReAct-style Coordinator, Extractor, Verifier and Risk Analyst agents; risk score is deterministic rules code, LLM only explains; verification uses mock APIs; every step logged to JSON audit trail.
sponsor_fit_note: Targeted at Goldman Sachs with a compliance-style vendor risk workflow using human-in-the-loop approval and audit logging; also uses NVIDIA Nemotron for explanations.
impact_claims_note: States onboarding can take up to six months; no measured results from the tool.

one_line_pitch: Developer service that detects breaking changes when upgrading API versions, using deterministic diffing guided by an agentic LLM.
problem_statement: Migrating to a new API version means tediously testing endpoints and hunting subtle response differences by hand.
distinctive_notes: Dashboard proxies API calls to protect tokens; uploaded request logs feed tests; deterministic diff engine is paired with Nemotron agent; multi-tenant auth only groundwork, not implemented.
sponsor_fit_note: Writeup does not mention State Farm specifically; it is a developer tool using Nvidia's Nemotron model.

one_line_pitch: Smart-glasses video is analyzed by a YOLO model to auto-build car and property listings with condition scores, plus an AI chat that recommends matching listings.
problem_statement: Online car and property listings rely on subjective descriptions, so buyers cannot easily judge real condition.
target_user: car and home buyers and listing creators
distinctive_notes: Used event-provided Voxel smart glasses; team patched a buggy SDK and trained a local YOLO detector because the default API was slow; car data scraped from Cars.com.
sponsor_fit_note: Built the hardware-track entry on the event-provided smart glasses, running a custom vision model against their SDK to capture defects.

one_line_pitch: Wearable Arduino badge that senses heat and humidity hazards and lets teammates exchange silent vibration/LED alerts, with a React ticket dashboard.
problem_statement: Technicians in loud, hazardous workplaces cannot reliably hear or see danger or communicate with teammates.
target_user: Industrial technicians working in noisy environments
distinctive_notes: Breadboard prototype with DHT11 sensor, LCD, LEDs, buzzer and two Arduinos exchanging serial alerts; also an AutoCAD badge model, Figma design and React dashboard on simulated data.

tech_items.name: Model Context Protocol / VS Code extension

one_line_pitch: Agentic dev tool that watches coding sessions in VS Code and generates searchable summaries so developers can regain context after switching projects.
problem_statement: Students switching between coding projects lose the reasoning, pending tasks and mental model behind their code.
target_user: student and hobbyist developers juggling several projects
distinctive_notes: Three-part system: React dashboard, VS Code extension exposing an MCP-style HTTP endpoint, and FastAPI agent that sends git changelogs to GPT-4.1-mini. README claims a 1st place grand prize (unverified).
